message: Execution scope mismatch: the type '{0}' is {1}, but its base type or interface '{2}' is {3}.
title: Execution scope mismatch between a type and its base type or interface.
rationale: The title mentions type arguments, but the only report site (TemplatingCodeValidator.Visitor.VerifyTypeDeclaration) compares the scope of the type with the scope of each entry of its base list. The message calls an implemented interface a 'base type', which is imprecise because the most common case is an interface.
